articles.title_en: Regulatory leakage among financial advisors: Evidence from FINRA regulation of “bad” brokers
articles.title_cn: 金融顾问中的监管泄漏：来自FINRA对“不良”经纪人监管的证据
articles.abstract_en: The regulatory framework for financial advisors is fragmented, with multiple state and federal regulators. Prior empirical literature on financial advisors has largely focused on a single subset of financial advisors, but we create a database containing brokers regulated primarily by FINRA, investment advisers regulated by the SEC or state securities regulators, and insurance producers regulated by state insurance regulators. There is significant overlap across the regimes; more than 40% of the advisors in our data are registered with more than one regulator. This overlap has implications for labor allocation and market discipline. For example, of the individuals who exit FINRA’s broker regime, 79% were jointly registered in insurance upon exiting FINRA’s regime. This could be efficient if it reflects bad actors who transition to lower risk work, but our evidence shows that these advisors continue to engage in financial planning after they move to the insurance side, as over 90% maintain licenses to sell annuities. Moreover, those who committed misconduct when regulated by FINRA continue to have heightened levels of misconduct in insurance. Our findings have additional implications for regulatory discipline. In 2018 and 2019, FINRA proposed rules designed to nudge “bad” brokers out of the industry. We show that these proposals caused thousands of high-risk brokers to exit the FINRA broker regime, but that the majority of these individuals did not leave financial services—98% are currently registered with state regulators as insurance producers.
articles.abstract_cn: 金融顾问的监管框架是分散的，涉及多个州和联邦监管机构。先前关于金融顾问的实证文献主要集中于金融顾问的一个子集，但我们创建了一个数据库，包含主要由FINRA监管的经纪人、由SEC或州证券监管机构监管的投资顾问，以及由州保险监管机构监管的保险生产者。各监管体系之间存在显著重叠；我们数据中超过40%的顾问在多个监管机构注册。这种重叠对劳动力分配和市场纪律有影响。例如，在退出FINRA经纪人体系的个人中，79%在退出FINRA体系时同时注册了保险。如果这反映了转向低风险工作的不良行为者，这可能是有效的，但我们的证据显示，这些顾问在转向保险领域后继续从事财务规划，因为超过90%的人持有销售年金的执照。此外，那些在FINRA监管下有过不当行为的人在保险领域的不当行为水平仍然较高。我们的发现对监管纪律还有额外的影响。在2018年和2019年，FINRA提出了旨在推动“不良”经纪人退出行业的规则。我们表明，这些提议导致数千名高风险经纪人退出FINRA经纪人体系，但这些个体中的大多数并未离开金融服务行业——98%目前作为保险生产者在州监管机构注册。

articles.title_en: Data and welfare in credit markets
articles.title_cn: 信贷市场中的数据与福利
articles.abstract_en: We show how to measure the welfare effects arising from increased data availability. When lenders have more data on prospective borrower costs, they can charge prices that are more aligned with these costs. This increases total social welfare and transfers surplus across borrower types. We show that under certain assumptions the magnitudes of these welfare changes can be estimated using only quantity and price data. Applying our methodology to bankruptcy flag removal, we find that in a counterfactual world where bankruptcy flags are never removed from credit reports, previously-bankrupt borrowers’ surplus decreases substantially, whereas efficiency increases only modestly.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们展示了如何衡量数据可得性增加所带来的福利效应。当贷款人拥有更多关于潜在借款人成本的数据时，他们可以设定更贴近这些成本的价格。这增加了总社会福利，并在不同借款人类型之间转移剩余。我们证明，在特定假设下，这些福利变化的幅度可以仅使用数量和价格数据来估计。将我们的方法应用于破产标记移除，我们发现，在一个破产标记从未从信用报告中移除的反事实世界中，先前破产借款人的剩余大幅减少，而效率仅适度提高。

articles.abstract_en: We estimate financial institutions’ portfolio tilts related to U.S. stocks’ environmental, social, and governance (ESG) characteristics. From 2012 to 2023, ESG-related tilts consistently total about 6% of the investment industry’s assets and rise from 17% to 27% of institutions’ total portfolio tilts. Significant ESG tilts arise from the choice of stocks held and, especially, the weights on stocks held. The largest institutions tilt increasingly toward green stocks, while other institutions and households tilt increasingly brown. Divestment from brown stocks is typically partial rather than full, even for individual mutual funds. UNPRI signatories and European institutions tilt greener; banks tilt browner.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了金融机构与美国股票的环境、社会和治理（ESG）特征相关的投资组合倾斜。从2012年到2023年，ESG相关的倾斜始终约占投资行业资产的6%，并从机构总组合倾斜的17%上升至27%。显著的ESG倾斜源于所持股票的选择，尤其是所持股票的权重。最大的机构越来越倾向于绿色股票，而其他机构和家庭则越来越倾向于棕色股票。从棕色股票的撤资通常是部分而非完全的，即使对个别共同基金也是如此。UNPRI签署方和欧洲机构更倾向于绿色；银行则更倾向于棕色。

articles.title_en: Dealer balance sheets and bidding behavior in the Bank of England’s QE reverse auctions
articles.title_cn: 英格兰银行量化宽松反向拍卖中的交易商资产负债表与投标行为
articles.abstract_en: We study dealers’ bidding behavior in the Bank of England’s quantitative easing (QE) reverse auctions. Using a granular dataset on both accepted and rejected offers together with an equilibrium model of bidding behavior, we estimate dealers’ valuations of securities offered to the Bank of England. We also recover the rents accruing to dealers from participating in the auctions as opposed to liquidating gilts in the secondary market, thereby possibly causing prices to change. These rents or so-called ”liquidity benefits” are largest in the early phases of QE implemented during the Global Financial Crisis, suggesting that QE may be particularly effective in restoring smooth market functioning when market participants are facing large liquidity shocks. Finally, we document that dealers’ valuations vary significantly with the amount of interest rate risk acquired in the secondary gilt market before the auction and with dealers’ regulatory capital.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了交易商在英格兰银行量化宽松（QE）反向拍卖中的投标行为。利用包含被接受和拒绝报价的细粒度数据集以及投标行为的均衡模型，我们估计了交易商对提供给英格兰银行的证券的估值。我们还计算了交易商参与拍卖而非在二级市场清算金边债券所获得的租金，这可能导致价格变动。这些租金或所谓的“流动性收益”在全球金融危机期间实施的量化宽松早期阶段最大，表明当市场参与者面临大规模流动性冲击时，量化宽松可能在恢复市场平稳运行方面特别有效。最后，我们记录了交易商的估值随拍卖前在二级金边债券市场获得的利率风险量以及交易商的监管资本而显著变化。

articles.abstract_en: Using cross-country and German administrative data on robotization, we show that the impact of robots on firms and labor markets is limited. First, investment in robots is small and highly concentrated in a few industries, representing less than 0.3% of aggregate expenditures on equipment. Second, robotization does not grow as rapidly as Information Technology did in the past, and current growth is driven by gains in developing countries. Third, firms invest in robots when they face difficulties in finding workers and subsequently increase employment after the investment. The total employment effect in exposed industries and regions is negative but modest in magnitude. We discuss why the effects of robots are limited and demonstrate that other digital technologies have more potential for large economic impact.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用跨国和德国关于机器人化的行政数据，我们表明机器人对企业和劳动力市场的影响有限。首先，机器人投资规模小且高度集中于少数行业，仅占设备总支出的不到0.3%。其次，机器人化的增长速度不及过去信息技术的增长，当前增长主要由发展中国家的收益驱动。第三，企业在招聘工人遇到困难时投资于机器人，并在投资后增加就业。在受影响的行业和地区，总就业效应为负，但幅度不大。我们讨论了机器人影响有限的原因，并证明其他数字技术具有更大的经济影响潜力。

articles.title_en: Global sales, international currencies, and the currency denomination of debt
articles.title_cn: 全球销售、国际货币与债务的货币计价
articles.abstract_en: We document that the currency denomination of the debt of large firms in developed countries is strongly associated with the geographical distribution of their sales. Furthermore, those firms exhibit significant home currency bias and international currency bias in borrowing: controlling for the geography of sales, they borrow more in their home currency and the two most traded currencies, the US dollar and the euro. We also show that the firms’ debt currency denomination choices are associated with export invoicing currency patterns in a way consistent with a currency hedging mechanism. In particular, firms domiciled in countries that invoice a larger share of their exports in either their home currency or in a vehicle currency exhibit a weaker connection between the currency denomination of their debt and the geography of their sales. Moreover, firms in countries that invoice more of their exports in an international currency are characterized by stronger international currency bias in debt issuance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了发达国家大型企业的债务货币计价与其销售地理分布密切相关。此外，这些企业在借款中表现出显著的本币偏好和国际货币偏好：在控制销售地理分布后，它们更多地以本币以及两种交易最频繁的货币——美元和欧元——借款。我们还表明，企业的债务货币计价选择与出口发票货币模式相关联，这与货币对冲机制一致。特别是，位于出口中以本币或载体货币计价比例较高的国家的企业，其债务货币计价与销售地理分布之间的联系较弱。此外，在出口中更多使用国际货币计价的国家，其企业在债务发行中表现出更强的国际货币偏好。

articles.abstract_en: We propose a framework to study regulatory complexity, based on concepts from computer science. We distinguish different dimensions of complexity, classify existing measures, develop new ones, compute them on three examples — Basel I, the Dodd–Frank Act, and the European Banking Authority’s reporting rules — and test them using experiments and a survey on compliance costs. We highlight two measures that capture complexity beyond the length of a regulation. We propose a quantitative approach to the policy trade-off between regulatory complexity and precision.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们基于计算机科学的概念，提出了一个研究监管复杂性的框架。我们区分了复杂性的不同维度，对现有度量方法进行分类，开发新的度量方法，并在三个实例——巴塞尔协议I、多德-弗兰克法案以及欧洲银行管理局的报告规则——上计算这些度量，并通过实验和一项关于合规成本的调查进行测试。我们强调了两种能够捕捉超出法规长度之外的复杂性的度量方法。我们提出了一种定量方法，用于处理监管复杂性与精确性之间的政策权衡。

articles.title_en: How valuable is corporate adaptation to crisis? Estimates from Covid-19 work-from-home announcements
articles.title_cn: 企业危机适应性的价值几何？基于Covid-19居家办公公告的估计
articles.abstract_en: This article investigates predictors and benefits of corporate adaptation to crisis, adding a new dimension to studies of flexibility and resilience based on ex ante characteristics. We produce a unique sample of work-from-home announcements scraped from company websites during Covid-19. The announcers’ valuations increased by 3%–5% and risk declined versus matches, consistent with real-options theory under asymmetric information. We estimate characteristics, including subtle textual topics from 10-Ks, that predicted adaptation, show faster price response following Bloomberg coverage, and real advantages in subsequent operating performance. Corporate adaptation to crisis adds value and reduces risk, beyond information in firm characteristics.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了企业危机适应的预测因素及其收益，为基于事前特征的灵活性与韧性研究增添了新维度。我们通过抓取Covid-19期间公司网站上的居家办公公告，构建了一个独特样本。公告公司的估值上升了3%–5%，且风险相对于匹配公司有所下降，这与信息不对称下的实物期权理论相符。我们估计了包括从10-K文件中提取的细微文本主题在内的特征，这些特征预测了适应性，并展示了彭博报道后价格反应更快，以及后续经营业绩中的实际优势。企业危机适应性增加了价值并降低了风险，超越了公司特征中所包含的信息。

articles.title_cn: 异质性客户群体与交易商网络
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a search-based model of OTC markets in which clients with heterogeneous trading needs direct their trades to one of ex-ante identical dealers. The main insight of the paper is that the way clients sort across dealers shapes dealer-to-dealer trading patterns and, in turn, generates a core–periphery interdealer network structure. Dealers in the model become heterogeneous because they attract different clients in equilibrium. Some dealers attract clients who trade frequently (e.g., index funds); others attract clients with infrequent trading needs (e.g., pension funds). Dealers attracting clients with frequent trading needs receive a larger volume of client orders, trade more with other dealers, and, as a result, form the core of the interdealer network. Conversely, dealers specializing in clients with infrequent trading needs form the periphery. I also show that accounting for client heterogeneity across dealers (a) challenges standard measurements and interpretations of bid–ask spreads and (b) generates predictions on bid–ask spreads and dealer centrality consistent with the empirical literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个基于搜索的场外交易市场模型，在该模型中，具有异质性交易需求的客户将其交易导向事前相同的交易商之一。本文的主要见解是，客户在交易商之间的分类方式塑造了交易商之间的交易模式，并进而产生了核心-外围的交易商间网络结构。模型中的交易商因在均衡中吸引不同的客户而变得异质。一些交易商吸引频繁交易的客户（如指数基金）；其他交易商则吸引交易需求不频繁的客户（如养老基金）。吸引频繁交易客户的交易商收到更大规模的客户订单，与其他交易商交易更多，因此形成了交易商间网络的核心。相反，专门服务于交易需求不频繁客户的交易商则形成了外围。我还表明，考虑客户在交易商间的异质性（a）挑战了买卖价差的标准测量和解释，（b）产生了与实证文献一致的关于买卖价差和交易商中心性的预测。
